# Desktop Android Notes

> An independent guide to MSI App Player. It covers what the emulator does, what it needs and how to fix the start error MSI documents, and it sends you to MSI's own download.

Independent guides to Www.Msi.Com by Desktop Android Notes. Facts come from the vendor's pages on the date shown on each page.

## Decide
- [MSI App Player review: free BlueStacks power with an MSI badge](https://msiappplayer.github.io/review.html): MSI App Player review: MSI's free BlueStacks based emulator, Console Mode, multiple instances, the 240 FPS claim, the virtualization catch and our score.
- [MSI App Player system requirements: what MSI states and what the engine needs](https://msiappplayer.github.io/system-requirements.html): MSI App Player system requirements: what MSI publishes (nothing), BlueStacks engine minimums of 4 GB RAM and 5 GB disk, virtualization and Hyper-V rules.

## Do it
- [MSI App Player download: the official installer and how to set it up](https://msiappplayer.github.io/download.html): Download MSI App Player free from MSI: what the installer includes, what MSI does not publish (version, size), what to check first and the install steps.
- [How to use MSI App Player: controllers, several games at once and the right GPU](https://msiappplayer.github.io/how-to-use.html): How to use MSI App Player: install games, enable Console Mode with Back + RB, run several games with the Multi-Instance Manager and pick the right GPU.
- [Cannot start MSI App Player: the virtualization conflict and how to fix it](https://msiappplayer.github.io/cannot-start-fix.html): Fix the Cannot start MSI App Player message: close VirtualBox or VMware, adjust Hyper-V, turn off Memory integrity, enable VT in BIOS. Steps from MSI's KB.

## Compare
- [MSI App Player vs BlueStacks 5: same engine, different wrapper](https://msiappplayer.github.io/vs-bluestacks.html): MSI App Player vs BlueStacks 5: same engine, but different extras, documentation, Mac support and update source. A side by side table to help you pick one.
- [MSI App Player alternatives: other ways to run Android games on a PC](https://msiappplayer.github.io/alternatives.html): MSI App Player alternatives: BlueStacks, Google Play Games for PC, LDPlayer, MEmu, NoxPlayer, Android Studio Emulator and Waydroid, and when each one fits.

## Full text
- [llms-full.txt](https://msiappplayer.github.io/llms-full.txt): every guide on this site in plain markdown
